title: 人口
one_line: 一定区域内人的总体；其规模与结构通过劳动供给、储蓄与需求影响长期增长。
overview:
（据 Wikipedia「Population」摘要归纳）Population may refer to:Population (biology), a group of individuals
Wildlife population, group of non-human individuals
Population (album), by The Most Serene Republic, 2007
Population, a group of human individuals
Population (journal), published by Institut national d'études démographiques
Statistical population, a set of similar items or events of interest for some question or experiment
Stellar population, categorized groups of stars within the Milky Way
World population, total number of living humans on Earth 具体定义边界与争议待核实。
comparison: 与**劳动人口**的区别在"范围"：人口是全体居民；劳动人口是其中处于劳动年龄且参与劳动市场者（劳动参与率×适龄人口）。这一区分在增长分析中很关键：人口红利来自**劳动人口占比**高（抚养比低），而非人口总量大；人口老龄化通过抚养比上升、储蓄下降与财政压力影响增长（见 secular-stagnation）。危机中，人口结构决定调整的承受力（年轻社会更易消化失业冲击）。
